name: ProvenAir
summary: AI and OCR that scan maintenance records to build back-to-birth trace histories for life-limited parts, with exception reports for missing paperwork.
paragraphs: AI and OCR that scan maintenance records to build back-to-birth trace histories for life-limited parts, with exception reports for missing paperwork.
whyItMatters: Back-to-birth gaps stall engine, landing gear and part sales; this speeds trace review for lessors, MROs and traders.
